description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the AuthenticationService class within the OrangeHRM project. It tests various scenarios of setting user credentials, including invalid credentials, unassigned roles, disabled users, terminated employees, and successful cases. The tests also verify interactions with session management and user service dependencies.

classes.name: AuthenticationServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for the AuthenticationService, covering credential setting scenarios.

methods.name: testsSetCredentialsWithInvalidCredentials
methods.description: Tests setting credentials with invalid credentials, expecting failure.

methods.name: testsSetCredentialsWithNotAssignedEss
methods.description: Tests setting credentials for a user with an 'ESS' role, expecting an employee not assigned error.

methods.name: testsSetCredentialsWithDisabledUser
methods.description: Tests setting credentials for a disabled user, expecting a user disabled error.

methods.name: testsSetCredentialsWithTerminatedEmployee
methods.description: Tests setting credentials for a terminated employee, expecting an employee terminated error.

methods.name: testsSetCredentialsWithoutEmployee
methods.description: Tests setting credentials when user has no associated employee, expecting an employee not assigned error.

methods.name: testsSetCredentials
methods.description: Tests successful setting of user credentials, verifying session variables are set.
